Our bedrooms
Our bedrooms
Every one of our bedrooms in our London hotel is cleverly designed to maximise space, style and sleep. Interiors inspired by Dutch design, using natural, durable and re-purposed materials. Ensuite bathrooms fitted with walk-in rain showers and locally-made toiletries. And for every good night’s sleep, you help a disadvantaged child go to school for a week.

Eat and drink
Come and hang out in our oversized communal areas at Good Hotel London. The Living Room is where you get social. Our sustainable restaurant serves amazing dishes all day. If you fancy winding down with a drink, head to the bar for locally brewed beers or to the Roof for signature cocktails and the most amazing views over London.

Good Hotel | Our Story | Good Hotel - The Socially Responsible Hotel
It all started with a pair of shoes...
2006
Marten Dresen, the founder of the Good Hotel, was travelling through Guatemala when he met Mirna, a girl with no shoes. He bought her a pair of Converse trainers, kicking off a charitable chain reaction.
Soon after meeting Mirna, Marten founded Niños de Guatemala, a foundation that builds and operates schools in rural Guatemalan communities.
Learn more about Mirna and her flamed Converse
Niños de Guatemala
Marten, together with his good friend Sander, former Spanish teacher Carmen, and sister Annemiek, started a Foundation that would open a first elementary school, Nuestro Futuro , in 2009 the village of Ciudad Vieja. In 2012, they opened a second elementary school, called El Porvenir , in San Lorenzo el Cubo. Then in 2015, a secondary school was inaugurated.
Learn more about Niños de Guatemala
2012
Once the first schools were up and running, Marten began to wonder how to generate a sustainable income for the charity and create quality jobs for the children that graduate from the schools. What if he could harness the potential of tourism?
The idea for the Good Hotel was created in 2012. From the start, Marten set out to build the Good Hotel and the Good Group on the principles of "social business", as per Muhamad Yunus.
Learn more about the hotel as a social business
The original Good Hotel
The first Good Hotel was conceived in Antigua.
Read the full story and watch the videos
2013
The concept for the Good Hotel was launched to the public in a 2 Michelin star restaurant in Amsterdam. This is also when the customary Good Training program got piloted, training local residents out of unemployment and into a hospitality career.
Learn more about the launch event
The Good Hotel that floats
Marten spotted an old derelict accommodation platform, which was for sale in the port of Amsterdam. He had a flash of insight: what if it could be converted into a beautiful hotel? Which could then be transported to Brazil, where it could serve as legacy project for the Olympics of 2016?
An Olympic legacy for Rio
2015
In order to "practice" running the floating Good Hotel before moving it to Brazil, the city of Amsterdam offered up a temporary mooring location. This is where the floating Good Hotel Amsterdam was in 2015 and 2016, as a pop-up. Four months before the hotel opening date, the first full-fledged Good Training program kicked off.
Kicking off the Good Training program
Across the North Sea
Well before the Olympics, Brazil entered into a deep recession. The floating Good Hotel had to change course. In October of 2016, it was towed on top of a submersible cargo barge, and started its voyage across the North Sea. Destination: London.
Learn about the landing in London
2017
Late 2016, the floating Good Hotel arrived into London. And though the shore connections took a while, both the hotel and the local training program successfully got going in 2017.
The brand
Over the course of 2019 and 2020, the Good Hotel brand was refreshed under the 'sleep good, do good' campaign.
Read more about the brand
The London training program
The Good Training Program has trained up hundreds of local residents from the London Borough of Newham.
The BBC sent by Tom Kerridge to report on it.
Watch the video
2022
After some delay due to COVID, the Good Hotel Guatemala City finally opened in 2022.
Visit Good Hotel Guatemala City
Taste of Good dinner
On 9 October 2022 Good Hotel London hosted the Taste of Good Dinner to share stories. For this special occasion Guatemalan chef and good friend, Debora Fadul, came over.
Watch the video
Antigua hotel extension
In 2025, the Good Hotel Antigua will be extended with 25 rooms.
Watch the video

FAQ | Good Hotel London Excel O2
FAQ
About the hotel
What is Good Hotel all about?
First and foremost, every Good Hotel is designed for a great night’s sleep. And every time you stay with us, you’re doing good. We’re a social impact business, where profits are donated to educating children in Guatemala and retraining locals in the UK affected by unemployment to allow them to step into careers in hospitality. A stay at Good Hotel is a good deed done, as every time a guest stays at a Good Hotel, they help others in the community reach their full potential.
Where is Good Hotel located?
We are a floating hotel, located on the Royal Victoria dock right next to the IFS cable Cars that connect to the O2 Arena and a 5 minute stroll from the ExCeL Exhibition Centre.
What’s the nearest station?
The closest stations are Royal Victoria (DLR) and Custom House (Elizabeth Line). From Custom House, it’s a 10-minute walk along the dockside.
How do I get to central London from the hotel?
The quickest and most direct route to central London is via the Elizabeth line from Custom House station, which is just a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
How do I get to the ExCeL Centre?
The ExCel centre is just a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Simply head east along the dockside, and you’ll reach the venue in no time. You can ask our reception team to guide you.
Do you offer parking?
Complimentary accessible parking is available for Blue Badge holders, offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that we do not offer general guest parking.  However, paid parking is available nearby at ExCeL London (just a short walk away). We recommend using ExCeL car park (Weast Entrance) for the most convenient access.
For rates and availability, please visit: ExCeL Parking Information
Is smoking allowed?
No. We are a non-smoking hotel. There is a designated outdoor smoking area on the dockside near the bridge.
Rooms & Amenities
What types of rooms do you offer?
We offer a range of compact, minimalist rooms designed for a restful stay. Each features large windows, premium bedding, and all essentials for work or rest.
What size are the beds?
Our Good Room Double features one double bed, 160 x 200cm.
Our Twin Rooms feature two twin beds, each approx. 80 x 200cm.
Our Good Rooms on the Water, Corner Waterfront rooms and Snooze Rooms all feature a King Double bed, 200 x 200cm.
If you’re unsure which room type is right for you, please feel free to contact our Reservations team and we will be happy to help you choose.
What amenities are included in the rooms?
All rooms include a private workspace, cubby storage, hanging area, blowdryer, safe, hot water kettle, and in-room tea and coffee.
Do the rooms have fridges or microwaves?
Our rooms do not have a fridge. If you need to store any essential items, please feel free to contact our reception. We will be happy to assist you.
Do the rooms have safes?
Yes, every guest room includes a safe for storing your valuables.
Do the rooms have TVs?
No, in line with our minimalist concept, we do not include TVs in guest rooms.
Is there WiFi?
High-speed, free WiFi can be accessed anywhere in our hotels.
Can I view a room before booking?
You are very welcome to arrange a viewing before booking. Please contact our Reservations team on reservations.london@goodhotel.co to schedule a suitable time.
Reservations & Arrival
Can I change or cancel my booking?
Yes, changes or cancellations depend on your booking policy. For assistance, contact  reservations.london@goodhotel.co .
What time is check in and check out?
Check-in any time after 3:00 pm, check-out any time before 11:00 am.
We do offer early check-in and late check-out, subject to availability and for an additional fee. Get in touch with the team, and we’ll do our best to accommodate your request.
Do you offer luggage storage?
Yes, you’re welcome to store your luggage with us on the day of arrival or departure. We do not store luggage overnight outside those times.
What other services are available?
Luggage storage, Dry cleaning services, Ironing room, Meeting and events spaces, Taxi and limousine services.
Can I receive mail or parcels during my stay?
We accept mail or packages for guests during their stay and a few days prior to arrival date. Please ensure that the name on the package matches the name on your reservation.
Why hasn’t my deposit been returned yet?
When you check in, we place a temporary pre-authorisation on your card, not an actual charge.
If no additional charges during checkout are made, this hold is released automatically after check-out. Depending on your bank, it may take a few working days to disappear from your account.
If you’re unsure, feel free to contact your bank or reach out to us.
Food & Drink
Is there a restaurant on-site?
Yes. Our Living Room Restaurant is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Buffet Breakfast: Mon - Sat | 07:00 – 10:30 Sun | 07:30 – 11:00
All day sharing menu: Mon - Sun | 12:00 – 22:00
Bar: Mon - Sun 12:00 – 23:00
How do I book a table?
You can reserve a table by contacting our reception or dining team directly at the hotel or visit tableo.com
Do you offer room service?
No, but our restaurant is on the ground floor and serves food and drinks all day long.
Do you have a rooftop terrace?
Yes. Our Rooftop Terrace is open all summer long but is subject to availability, weather dependent and seasonal.  Mon - Fri 14:00 - 21:00, Sat - Sun 12:00-21:00
We recommend checking availability before arrival.
Meetings & Events
Can I host a meeting or event at Good Hotel?
Yes. We offer fully equipped spaces ranging from 8-person boardrooms to rooms that hold up to 70 guests in theater style. Our meeting rooms [The Blue Room, Sky Blue Room, and Pink Room] feature flexible layouts, bold colors, and waterfront views.
What’s included with each meeting room rental?
